tools.name: search_dpc_practices
tools.description: Search Tabflows' DPC Finder directory of direct primary care practices in the US by free text (name, city, doctor, specialty), state, city and practice model. Returns full listings including address, phone and doctor as on file, with the total match count for paging.

tools.name: get_dpc_practice
tools.description: One DPC Finder listing by slug, with every field its page shows and its canonical URL.

tools.name: quote_tabflows_price
tools.description: The monthly Tabflows price for a practice's number of locations and monthly paying patients, with a breakdown and the pricing rule. Always use this rather than quoting prices from memory or other pages.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: The tools Tabflows works with (EHRs, scribes, messaging, labs and more), optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: get_integration
tools.description: One integration by slug: what Tabflows does with that tool, its features and its page.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Documented Tabflows workflows: what triggers each one, its steps, the outcome and the time it saves.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search over tabflows.com page titles and summaries (product, pricing, FAQs, compliance, glossary, blog, integrations). Returns page ids to pass to fetch. DPC Finder listings are not indexed here; use search_dpc_practices.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full markdown of a tabflows.com page by id (a site path such as /pricing, as returned by search).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full markdown of any public tabflows.com page by path, e.g. /pricing, /faqs, /compliance, /glossary, /dpc-finder/texas.

tools.name: get_demo_booking_link
tools.description: Links for the human to book a Tabflows demo or sign up. Books nothing itself; the person completes it.

tools.name: dpc_break_even
tools.description: How many members a direct primary care practice needs to break even, from its average monthly membership fee, the owner's annual pay goal, monthly overhead and per-member cost. Any input left out uses the calculator page's default. Returns the panel size, monthly fixed costs, revenue at break-even a

tools.name: dpc_startup_cost
tools.description: Estimated launch budget for a direct primary care practice: one-time setup costs plus a runway reserve (monthly burn times runway months), and the total with a 15% cushion. Start from a preset ("lean", "office" or "staffed"; default "office") and override any line item. Dollar amounts, rough plannin

tools.name: get_demo_availability
tools.description: Open times on the Tabflows demo calendar, grouped by meeting length. Every start time is a UTC ISO timestamp; convert it before showing it to the person. Pass the person's IANA timezone: it picks the month to read, and the same timezone passed to book_demo sets the time zone of the booking and the i

tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Book a time on the Tabflows demo calendar for the person you are helping, using a startTime and the durationMinutes it was listed under in get_demo_availability. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dpc_practice · Private data: search_dpc_practices · Public sink: book_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dpc_practice · Private data: search_dpc_practices · Public sink: book_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
